picks.editorial_note: An $874 million federal commitment to semiconductor R&D directly targets the compute bottleneck constraining AI progress nationwide — one of the largest single funding actions in this week's coverage with implications for the entire US AI supply chain.
picks.title: Department of Commerce Announces Letters of Intent With 7 Companies for $874 Million to Accelerate Semiconductor R&D for the Compute Supply Chain

picks.editorial_note: An AI agent autonomously exploiting vulnerabilities to breach production systems during a security test, without human direction, is a watershed moment for AI safety and signals that regulators and industry will need to rethink cybersecurity norms for increasingly agentic models.
picks.title: OpenAI’s models autonomously hacked a tech startup. It signals a seismic shift in cybersecurity

picks.editorial_note: Texas A&M's entry into the DOE's Genesis Mission exemplifies a new model of coordinated government-industry-academia investment in AI and supercomputing for scientific discovery, with implications reaching well beyond one campus.
picks.title: Texas A&M University joins the Genesis Mission to transform science using artificial intelligence – Texas A&M Stories

picks.editorial_note: Automating scientific discovery itself with AI agents — applied here to quantum computing research — represents a genuine shift in how science gets done, backed by direct DOE funding.
picks.title: A Pitt-led team plans to automate quantum computing research with a Department of Energy grant

picks.editorial_note: A concrete three-way collaboration between a university, a national lab, and an energy company using AI to solve nuclear fuel recycling tackles a real bottleneck in clean energy expansion.
picks.title: Case Western Reserve University partnering with Argonne National Laboratory on Genesis Mission grant to harness power of AI to unlock recycling of nuclear fuel | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's participation in a global AI Materials Foundry network shows how AI-driven design and robotic experimentation are accelerating materials discovery at industrial scale, a foundational capability for next-generation technology.
picks.title: Cambridge researchers contribute to AI Materials Foundry

picks.editorial_note: The release of Apertus 1.5, a fully open multimodal large language model trained on European supercomputing infrastructure, is a significant contribution to open AI research amid growing reliance on closed, proprietary models.
picks.title: Apertus 1.5: Building the next generation of open AI infrastructure

picks.editorial_note: A forensic tool developed with YouTube and Google DeepMind that can trace AI-generated fake videos back to their source model addresses one of the most pressing real-world harms of generative AI: the spread of undetectable synthetic media.
picks.title: New tool identifies the sources of fake videos

picks.editorial_note: A deep-learning algorithm achieving high-accuracy cancer mutation detection across multiple cancer types demonstrates AI's growing clinical value in oncology diagnostics.
picks.title: HKU School of Computing and Data Science research team develops ClairS, achieving high-accuracy cancer mutation detection across multiple cancer types - All News - Media - HKU

picks.editorial_note: A PNAS study finding that widely used AI protein-structure tools like AlphaFold2 routinely violate basic physical rules is an important corrective for a scientific community increasingly dependent on these tools, with real implications for research reliability.
picks.title: AI Growing Pains Reach Scientific Labs, New RPI Study Finds
